name: Against All Odds
description: For each combat tag you have on your character, increase your damage by 2% (max of 14%).
notes: Works in PvE combat, with each mob counting as an individual combat tag.

name: Emergency Reserves
description: When you get hit below 20% health, gain 20% tempo immediately.
notes: 3 minute cooldown.

name: Unswayed
description: The effects of Taunt and Encore no longer work on you. (+20 Sanity)
notes: The Taunt Mantra, and the "Cornered Fool" Talent can no longer inflict "Taunt" on the user.
The Sing Mantra can no longer use the Talent "Encore" on the user, nullifying the stun effect.
Sing can still apply Charm/Overcharm to the user.

name: Kick Off
description: You easily brush off shorter falls, taking no damage. Your first wall jump will always send you higher than normal. Gain a speed boost after wall jumping over a wall. (+6 Passive Agility)

Increases climb distance by ~15% when off cooldown.
Slide jumping now also slightly increases climb distance.

name: Steady Footing
description: You're much more resistant to being pushed around. (+5 Carry Load, +2 Passive Agility)

This is a considerable downside to Frostdraw users, as there is no upside to this effect, it is not recommended.
The Fur Parka equipment has this Talent.

name: Time To Go
description: Taking a life grants a speed boost for 10 seconds. Taking a player's life doubles the speed boost and the duration. (+1 Passive Agility)
notes: Provides a 25% speed boost, doubling to 50% when killing a player.
Procs all speed boost related talents. (ex. Speed Demon)
Duration is visually represented by a red glow by the user's eyes.
Can stack, allowing the user to build tremendous speed by executing multiple targets at once.

name: An Ironsinger's Instinct
description: Successfully dodging an attack coats you in metal and reduces the damage of the next attack taken.
notes: After dodging gain the status effect for 2 seconds, reducing the damage of the next hit by 60%.
The user visually gains a grey metallic shine upon for the duration, clearing on hit.
Has a cooldown of 18 seconds, starting immediately upon dodge.

name: Exposed Durability
description: Deal 10% more damage to opponents with no armor durability left.
notes: Also affect players with no outfit (Stranded Outfit)
Always procs on your Basic Attacks if you have Berserk active, and with any attack against Berserk users.

name: Phantom Edge
description: Your weapon Basic Attacks have +0.25 range.
notes: It is greatly not recommended to spend a talent hand on this, as the effect of this talent is objectively unnoticeably minuscule.
Stacks with Duelist's Lunge for more range.

name: Everchanging Aegis
description: You take 20% less from attacks the same element as the last element you were hit with, but 10% more damage from attacks from different element.
notes: Getting hit by another element immediately changes your resistance to that element. i.e Getting hit by Shadowcast Mantras while having Galebreathe resistance will immediately change your resistance type to Shadowcast and vice versa.
This means that multi-hitting Mantras are much less potent, even if your Everchanging Aegis type was not attuned to that Mantra.
Your Aegis type can swap on block, dodge, and parry. You do not need to actually be hit by the attack for the swap to occur, largely mitigating the downside.
and self damage do not proc Everchanging Aegis.
The damage type you become resistant to is indicated by a colored shield, continuous damage of the same element will give a colored outline of the damage type.
Flamecharm: Orange / Frostdraw: Blue / Thundercall: Yellow / Galebreathe: Green / Shadowcast: Purple / Ironsing: Grey / Bloodrend: Red
Does not affect attacks that do not deal elemental damage.

name: Neural Overload
description: You can input up to 4 copies of each Mantra ingredient instead of being limited to 3.
notes: The Mantra Modifiers limit is increased from 3 -> 4, for copies of modifiers. (ex. max of 3 crystal lens -> max of 4 crystal lens)
Removing this talent after modifying mantras will not alter their pre-existing modifiers, keeping the benefit.
This will not change the maximum 12 mantra modification hard limit.

name: Overflowing Dam
description: Having full Ether for 2 seconds or more grants an aura to your attacks that grant them 10% more damage.
notes: For every point of Intelligence below 40, Overflowing Dam's damage bonus will be reduced by 0.125%, having a minimum damage buff of 6.875% at 15 Intelligence.
For Warlock's Mantle, you will gain a 5.625% damage buff at 5 Intelligence; for Khan with this equipment, you will gain a 5.25% damage buff at 2 Intelligence or a 5% damage buff at 0 Intelligence.
The damage buff applies the moment you reach 100% Ether, despite what the Talent description says.
The Warlock's Mantle equipment has this Talent.

name: Perfect Flash
description: Having over 95% health causes your mantras to do +25% damage. This damage bonus will scale down to 10% if your enemies are far away.
notes: Poser's ring won't count towards the health threshold until sheathed, maintaining the bonus even after being "damaged".

name: Wyvern's Claw
description: You deal 10% more damage while airborne. Mantras receive a 5% damage increase instead.
notes: Activates after not being in contact with a grounded surface for ~0.75 seconds.
Synergizes very well with uppercuts.

name: Aerogliding
description: When falling from a high place, hold spacebar to generate wind currents until you hit the floor. (+2 Passive Agility)
notes: Has a windup of 1 second.
When active, create an aura that reduces fall speed and stopping fall damage.
Does not prevent existing fall damage, if user was already falling, Aerogliding may still damage the user upon activation.
Automatically ends after 5 seconds, although it can be reactivated midair up to 3 times, however the windup will cause the user to take fall damage.
By air stalling you can continually reactivate Aerogliding and prevent fall damage.
When active, also lightly pushes user forwards, giving the user control.
Greatly reduces height loss with glider, allowing for much longer distances to be traveled. (Stacks with Feathered Glider)

name: Aeronade
description: Your Galetrap automatically detonates on contact with an object. (+2 Passive Agility)

name: Suffocating Impact

name: Stifled Jump
description: Suffocating now applies Dazed if enemies jump. Suffocated PvE enemies now also get Sluggish when they are suffocated. (+2 Passive Agility)

description: Your Gale Punch pulls enemies in before you hit them.
notes: Gale punch mantra will now pull players towards the user during the windup of the mantra. (Cannot be feinted)
Increases the windup of Gale Punch by 0.1s, totalling to 0.65s.

name: Apothecary
description: Potions you prepare will have amplified positive effects when consumed, and amplified negative effects when thrown.
notes: Additively increases potion Potency by 125%. (More info on the potions page.)
The bonus acts similar to a potion ingredient, therefore Apothecary does nothing else after brewing.

description: When applying a potion effect to someone who already has one, the new effect is amplified. You have a 25% chance not to deplete potions when drinking them.
notes: Procs when a thrown potion replaces a different potion's effect. (Does not work on drank potions)

description: You no longer drop Potions on death.
notes: Saltchemist salts innately provide this feature to your potions, however are not manually droppable.

description: Drinking potions near allies will share the potion's effect with them.
notes: Also procs potion sickness, causing allies to throw up upon usage if they've ingested a potion recently.
Its effective range is exactly 30 studs.

name: Potion Quaffer
description: You're accustomed to drinking toxic fluids quickly. You'll get along famously with the other patrons at the tavern. Drinking potions slows less and grants superior regenerative effects to you.
notes: Drink potions 30% faster. Potions take 1.645s to drink rather than the base 2.35s. When in combat, potions with Health Restoration (instant or regen) whether positive or negative now take 2.85s to drink rather than the base 3.55s.

description: You have a chance to brew 2 potions instead of 1.
notes: 25% chance to gives a duplicate of the brewed potion.

description: Even when things look dire, you still have it in you to keep your legs moving. (+2 Passive Agility)
notes: Halve the speed penalty tied to lost health.
Currently does not work.

name: Scaredy Cat
description: When enemies initiate a fight first, gain a speed boost. (+2 Passive Agility)
notes: Gives you a 42.5% speed boost for 5s.

name: Conditioned Runner
description: You regenerate health faster than normal when sprinting below 75% HP. The health amount scales with your agility stat. (+1 Passive Agility)

name: Approaching Singularity
description: You now gain +1% Mantra PEN for every 10 point of Intelligence.
notes: Gives 0.1% Mantra PEN per point in Intelligence.
Provides +8% PEN at the requirement, and +10% PEN at 100 Intelligence.

name: Flame Within
description: An application of Pleeksty's concept of the inner flame, also known as the soul of man. Set yourself ablaze to gain more move speed and 10% extra damage.
notes: Unlike normal burn, Flame Within's burn is not cleared by rolling/sliding. Flame Within will not stop until 30 seconds have passed or until Flame Within is reused.
Generally dangerous to use without multiple sources of burn damage reduction, most notably, Immolation.

8 second cooldown that starts when Flame Within is activated. Meaning if you let it burn for long enough, the cooldown will effectively be nullified outside of burn immunity. The Talent tool does not showcase this properly.

notes: Toggling Null on/off has a 5 second cooldown.

notes: Works with Surge Path.

description: Lightning moves now apply stacks of "Resolve Crusher". At 4 stacks, you apply "Electrified" to your opponent. Attacks from Electrified opponents are converted into lightning damage, but will deal 10% less damage to you.
notes: Electrified targets have their damage on weapon attacks changed to Thundercall damage.

description: After being block broken, the next attack to hit you deals reduced damage.
notes: After being block broken, reduce the next instance of damage by 20%. This has no cooldown.

name: Reinforced Armor
description: Incoming PEN is reduced by 30%.
notes: The effects of Reinforced Armor are lessened if you do not meet the Talent's requirements, losing 0.8% PEN resistance per point below 90 Fortitude, capping at 10% PEN resistance at 65 Fortitude.
Alternatively, this can be stated as 10 + 0.8 * (Fortitude - 65) = RA effectiveness, though this cannot go below 10%.
PEN calculation: incoming PEN * (1 - 0.Reinforced Armor effectiveness) = reduced incoming PEN.
For example, 50% PEN vs 30% Reinforced Armor and 50% physical armor:
Base: 50% PEN vs 50% physical armor; 50 * (1 - 0.5) = 25% resistance after PEN.
Reinforced Armor: 50% PEN vs 30% RA; 50 * (1 - 0.3) = 35% PEN. 35% PEN vs 50% physical armor = 50 * (1 - 0.35) = 32.5% resistance after PEN.

The second hit does not count as a weapon hit, meaning it ignores your weapon's Chip stat, it cannot proc enchants, and it cannot proc any "on flourish" Talents.

description: Gain a bit of knockback resistance as well as damage resistance against attacks that ragdoll you.

description: The mystic eye through which you now see the world can perceive the imperceptible. Invisible foes are highlighted.

prerequisites.prereqValue: help 4 Pathfinders escape their Depths Trials
pay to the wall text you obtained the Oath from to skip Blindseer's progression entirely (requires you to have fully progressed the Oath at least once).

notes: Invisible players and monsters are revealed by a Blindseer Eye icon showcasing their current position.

name: Berserk
description: One with nothing to lose has everything to gain. Succumb to burning rage within and enter Berserk State.
notes: While in the Berserk State, your M1s will nullify your opponent's armor, bypassing it entirely, and your criticals will gain 10% PEN. However, your own armor bars, including Natural Armor, will be drained fully for the duration of the Berserk State.

notes: It has a cooldown of 5 seconds.
Only accessible when True Strength is active.

name: Lithe Step
description: When Sprinting, roll-cancel and instantly vanish and surge with unmatched speed
notes: Makes the player briefly invisible, similar to Jetstriker's Rush of Ancients.
Lithe Step will not provide immunity frames to your dodge, but grants a noticeable speed boost during it.
Lithe Step has a 3 second cooldown. This cooldown is reduced to 1 second while in True Strength.

name: Reveal

prerequisites.prereqValue: Defeat Mind Reflection for the third time.

notes: Grants a Talent tool. On cast, you stab yourself with your weapon, toggling on True Strength. Use the tool again to toggle True Strength back off.

name: Soaring Storm
description: Empower your uppercuts with the way of the blade, after Lithe Stepping, flourishing, or landing an Oath ability.

notes: Proc condition is removed and damage is increased if in True Strength.

Landing non weapon attacks (like Burn, Mantras, Eruptions, etc.) build up 1 stack each. Bleed does not build up stacks however.

prerequisites.prereqValue: 30 Light Weapon and have completed the Trig quest (helping The Summer Company)

notes: Mathematically speaking, Armor Piercing is effectively a multiplicative 10% increase to your PEN against blunt armor, applied after all other PEN sources, meaning Armor Piercing has heavy diminishing returns based on how much PEN you have.

While at 0% PEN, this effectively grants +10% PEN against blunt armor, but this amount gets reduced by 1% for every 10% PEN you have. The formula is as follows: (1 - ((1 - Current PEN/100) * (1 - 0.1))) * 100 = effective PEN against blunt armor.
For example: having 20% PEN + Armor Piercing is equivalent to having 28% PEN against blunt armor (+8).
Specific rifles benefit less from Armor Piercing than others due to their damage typings.
For Rifle Spear, this will only proc on critical, due to Rifle Spear being a slash based weapon.
For Stormseye and Rosen's Hellflame, they will only circumstantially benefit from Armor Piercing, because of their elemental damage.

In some circumstances, Armor Piercing may give your opponent higher weighting on their elemental resistances by lowering their blunt resistance, causing them to resist your damage based on their elemental resistance instead. Alternatively, if they have higher elemental resistance than blunt resistance, Armor Piercing will do nothing at all.

Currently does not work.
5 second cooldown.
Mutual Exclusive: Execution

name: Parting Gift
description: After you land a flourish, gain the ability to shoot bullets for 5 seconds. [Dual Gun]
notes: On proc, all dual gun M1s within the next 5 seconds have projectiles.
Procs even if your flourish is parried or blocked.
The projectile M1s from this Talent can proc True Ether Bullets.

name: Quickdraw
description: Allows you to fire your offhand gun right after swinging. [Not necessary on dual guns]
notes: Allows the user to instantly start attacking with their offhand gun after attacking with their main weapon

name: Quick Swap
description: Massively reduce your bullet swap cooldown. [Dual Gun]

name: Taste The Rainbow
description: Every time you shoot, switch your ammo type. [Dual Guns]
notes: Every M1 switches your Bullet type.

name: True Ether Bullets
description: Using Ether Bullets applies elemental damage of your highest investment.
notes: Landing 2 shots will make the 3rd shot deal elemental damage.
The 3rd shot apply your attunement's elemental effect:
Flamecharm: Your bullets apply burn/eruption (Lava Serpent)
Frostdraw: Your bullets apply chill/crystal (Crystallization)
Thundercall: Your bullets apply shock/surge stack (Surge)
Galebreathe: Your bullets after cut and apply winded briefly
Shadowcast: Your bullets drain ether/apply burn (Twisted Puppets)
Ironsing: Your bullets apply metal rods
Bloodrend: Your bullets apply blood poisoning
If the user has multiple attunements at the same level, it will use the first attunement in the priority list: Thundercall > Shadowcast > Flamecharm > Galebreathe > Frostdraw
If the user has no attunement, this Talent has NO EFFECT. It is recommended to put one point into an attunement if using this Talent on an attunement-less build.
This Talent does not make guns scale off your attunement attributes, it just converts your Physical Damage to Elemental Damage.
Despite the fact that you can obtain this from Greatcannons, this Talent does nothing on them.

name: Prime Ether Bullets
description: Your bullets take one less hit to proc elemental effects and now have slight intelligence scaling. [Dual Gun]
notes: True Ether Bullets now procs in 2 hits instead of 3.
Adds 1.2 Intelligence scaling to your Pistols. Stacks with the Rosen's Ring.

name: Brain Rattler
description: Guardbreaking an opponent with your Critical rattles their brain in its container, causing increased blood loss, applies Stagger to PvE enemies and blurs their vision.
notes: This Talent is bugged and procs on ALL guard breaks, including those from Mantras, non-critical attacks, or entirely different weapons.
The Stagger status effect makes your opponent take 33% more posture damage.

name: Dispatch
description: Bear Trapped targets deal 20% less posture. Dazed targets deal 20% less posture. This can stack.

name: Hammerfall
description: Aerial attacks do 25% more posture damage when blocked.

name: Fan the Flames
description: Your stored Wind mantras can now empower your Fire mantras.
notes: The effects of inhale (causing mantra modifiers to transfer across gale mantras) and the damage buff that Inhale grants, (Inhaled mantra's level times 2)%, will now also affect flame mantras.

name: All the Dead Gods
description: Your Basic Attacks now apply anti-heal and 5% Heal Boost against PvE for 8s. (+7 Sanity)
notes: Whenever you land an M1 or critical with the M1 tag, apply Anti-Heal for 8 seconds.

All the Dead Gods' anti-heal effectiveness for sources of active healing scales on your combined Willpower and Intelligence investment. This has a minimum value of 70% at 55 combined points of Intelligence and Willpower, and a maximum value of 100% at 105 combined points.
All the Dead Gods loses 0.6% anti-heal for every combined point of Intelligence and Willpower below 105. For example, 80 combined points will have 85% anti-heal.

All the Dead Gods' anti-heal effectiveness for sources of passive healing is always 100% regardless of your combined investment. Sources of passive healing include: campfires, Conditioned Runner, Curse of the No Life King, Chorus of Souls, and natural health regeneration.
Wearing a Ring of Pestilence increases All the Dead Gods' anti-heal duration by 4 seconds; from 8 to 12.
The anti-heal cannot be procced on allies, and it does not affect healthpacks.
The Heal Boost status effect increases all non-passive healing gained from enemies who are currently affected by your anti-heal. This Talent grants +5% Heal Boost.

name: All Above, Gods Below
description: Any healing your opponent were to receive while All The Dead Gods is active on them is stolen and given to you, increase your PvE Heal Boost to 15% as well. (+20 Sanity)
notes: Though not visually displayed, the duration of this effect is separate from your anti-heal.

All Above, Gods Below's duration scales on your Willpower and Intelligence investment. At 200 combined invest, it will last for the full duration of your All the Dead Gods. For every point below 200, All Above, Gods Below's duration will be reduced by 1% (relative to All the Dead Gods), down to a minimum of 50% of All the Dead Gods duration at 150 combined invest.
This will not proc if you are the one who applied the healing; you cannot heal yourself by healing your opponent.

This only procs on non-passive healing. For example (non exhaustive list): something like Flame Wisp, spits, or Bloodless Gem will proc this effect, but campfires, Conditioned Runner, or Curse of the No Life King will not.
The Heal Boost status effect increases all non-passive healing gained from enemies who are currently affected by your anti-heal. This Talent grants +15% Heal Boost.

name: Heretic's Sutra
description: A chant that steers you into the state of Insanity for 20 seconds.
notes: Heretic's Sutra has a base windup of 0.4s and a base cooldown of 24 seconds at 30 Willpower. For every point in Willpower above 30, the windup is reduced by 0.00429 seconds.
Has a windup of 0.186 seconds at 80 Willpower, a maximum windup of 0.293 seconds at 55 Willpower, and a minimum windup of 0.1 seconds at 100 Willpower.
Heretic's Sutra has a base cooldown of 24 seconds at 30 Willpower. For every point in Willpower above 30, the cooldown is reduced by 0.085s.
Has a cooldown of 19.71 seconds at 80 Willpower, a maximum cooldown of 21.86 seconds at 55 Willpower, and a minimum cooldown of 18 seconds at 100 Willpower.
Gives a burst of insanity to yourself.
Immediately lose 15% sanity on use.
If above 80% sanity, immediately lose sanity down to 65%.
You start benefitting from Talents that require insanity to use (namely )
Talents that need you to be losing sanity to proc are passively activated for 15 seconds.
Namely Shared Misery and .
Note that this passive does NOT work with , as it only procs based on your current sanity percentage. And while Heretic's Sutra can help with sanity loss, it does not passively activate .

name: Sin Stacker
description: Your All The Dead Gods' duration is now based on how many stacks of antiheal you already have on your opponent, increase your PvE Heal Boost to 10% instead. (+8 Sanity)
notes: By landing additional basic attacks on a target affected by All the Dead Gods' Anti-Heal, you can increase the duration of subsequently applied Anti-Heal stacks by 1 second per Anti-Heal stacks affected the target.
Starting at 1 Anti-Heal stack lasting 8 seconds, applying another will make the second stack last 9 seconds, and applying another will make the third stack last 10 seconds, etc.

As Anti-Heal stacks decay, the additional duration they apply to future stacks will be nullified. For example, if you apply Stack 1 for 8 seconds and Stack 2 for 9 seconds, then wait until Stack 1 runs out of duration before landing another hit, Anti-Heal from the third M1 will only last 9 seconds.
The Heal Boost status effect increases all non-passive healing gained from enemies who are currently affected by your anti-heal. This Talent grants +10% Heal Boost.

name: Brick Wall
description: You refuse. You cannot be knocked off your feet until you are knocked completely . Also reduces the duration of . (+5 Health, +2 Posture)
notes: The Knockdown duration reduction scales on your combined investment into the Willpower and Fortitude attributes, being fully negated if you have 100 points invested into both.
Gain total immunity to ragdoll, only being pushed back instead from moves that would normally ragdoll.
By extension, this makes you more resistant to knockback as a whole as the lack of ragdoll means you retain air friction.
Makes you resistant to the Eternal Gale, causing only momentary stun instead of ragdolling you.
Cap Artist is disabled with this Talent.

name: Mythic Stability
description: Players and regular mobs cannot instantly execute you while you're on your feet. Protects you from one instance of instant execution when . 60s CD.
notes: Works on attacks such as The Doom of Caeranthil's Sudden Ambush and Luminant Beam attacks that would normally insta-grip you. It will NOT, however, protect you against Blood Scourge or it's corrupted variant.

name: Not a Scratch
description: You don't show any signs of damage. (+2 Posture)
notes: Your character no longer visually shows any signs of damage no matter how low their HP is. No cuts, no scratches, no low hp anims, no torn clothing, etc.
Spotter (for your opponent's allies) / Rhythm no longer shows how much health your character has.
If you have less than 100 Willpower, your character has a chance to yell out in agony upon taking damage. This is purely visual.
These include: "HEEAAAAUUUUURRGHHH!!", "HEEAAAARRGH!!", "OHHHHH GODS THE AGONY!!", "YEAARURUGHH!!", "UUUURURGHHH!!", and "SWEET MEEEEEERRRRRCCCCCYYYY!!". Quite dramatic.
The Trickster's Habit and Jester's Garb Outfits have this Talent.

name: Peripheral Vision
description: Your glare now ignores if your opponent is facing you. (+5 Sanity)

name: Bottom Freeze
description: Hitting chilled enemies with Ice Projectiles while they are on ice freezes them to the ground.
notes: Prevents you from rotating your character and moving around overall.
Bottom Freeze will end early if damage is taken from any source.

name: Cryonis
description: All ice spells casted ontop of ice cost less Ether.
notes: Ice Mantras cost 20% less ether if casted while standing on ice.

name: Frost Buster
description: Greatsword Criticals and Greathammer Criticals now leave a place Ice below the path they carve.
notes: On critical, create three moderately large ice patches in a linear path in front of yourself. These patches last 1 minute 30 seconds.
Despite what the Talent description states, Greathammers do not proc Frost Buster but Greataxes do. Greatcannons do not proc Frost Buster either.
Frost Buster can only proc once per critical.
Also grants the ability to freeze and damage boats with Greatsword and Greataxe criticals.

Frost Buster procs on any critical when used on a Greatsword or Greataxe including some strange cases such as critical-replacing Enchantments (Curse of the Unbidden, Nemesis, and Stormbreaker) and all fist style criticals on Markor's Inheritor.
Because Frost Buster has no cooldown and has such a large amount of coverage, it is one of the best ice patch applicators in the game.

name: Frozen Anchor
description: Apply bottom freeze and chill to your opponent whenever you land a flourish, uppercut, or crit. 10s CD.
notes: Functions similarly to Meteor Impact, applying on any mantra that would proc it.
Bottom Freeze will be removed if the target takes damage from any source. This makes this Talent extremely ineffective on multihit criticals.
The Chill applied through this Talent has a 12 second duration, making it a strong option for hybrid builds that have limited opportunities to proc Chill.
Deals (0) Frostdraw damage as hitregistry for Chill. This allows you to proc certain Talents like Flashboil without any other source of Frostdraw damage.
Currently bugged and applies through block/parry/dodge.

name: Frostbite
description: Enemies can no longer heal when under the effect of your chill. PvE enemies also net you 5% more Heal Boost when they are chilled.
notes: The Heal Boost status effect increases all non-passive healing gained from enemies who are currently affected by your anti-heal. This Talent grants +5% Heal Boost.
Works with Glass Path: Crystallization.

name: Frozen Pin-Cushion
description: Ice Daggers now freeze opponents.
notes: With crystal path, instantly procs Crystallization upon landing on the target, knocking them backwards and deal more damage.

name: Saint Jay
description: When a Chilled enemy receives a heal, it's nullified and 60% of the healing is redirected to you. While this is active and they are on ice your rate of healing is increased, raise your PvE Heal Boost to 10% as well.
notes: This will not proc if you are the one who applied the healing; you cannot heal yourself by healing your opponent.

This only procs on non-passive healing. For example (non exhaustive list): something like Flame Wisp, spits, or Bloodless Gem will proc this effect, but campfires, Conditioned Runner, or Curse of the No Life King will not.
If using Glass Path: Crystallization then every hit with a Frostdraw mantra will proc Saint Jay for 2 seconds. (Doesn't stack)
The "on ice" effect of Saint Jay is bugged and does not work.
The Heal Boost status effect increases all non-passive healing gained from enemies who are currently affected by your anti-heal. This Talent grants +10% Heal Boost.

name: Stasis Strike
description: Your crystal explosions deal more damage whenever your opponent is also bottom frozen.
notes: Your Crystal detonations deal 67% more damage against targets who are bottom frozen.

name: Unyielding Frost
description: Your Chill can proc through block, with blocked Chilling proc lasting 80% of the duration.
notes: If you have less than 100 Frostdraw, your chilled duration (when applied through block) will be reduced down to 25% of its original duration instead.
Does not proc Frozen Legs.
Mutual Exclusive: Glass Path: Crystallization

name: Ignition Card
description: A card representing your membership in the Ignition Union. Entitles you to speedier experience gain from Dungeons and Jobs, though the fees will slightly reduce your experience gain outside of these.
notes: Gain increased EXP gain from Jobs and Dungeons, but reduced EXP gain from any other content.

name: Union Pager
description: Check up on job listings remotely.
notes: Grants a Talent tool that acts as a remote-access Job Board, allowing you to pick up jobs from any location.

name: Union Hook
description: You can now make use of the Ignition Union hooks to ascend or descend.
notes: Prerequsites: Save Epsi in the entrance of Firfire then speak to Alpha OR Ignition Delver Origin

name: Agitating Spark
description: Applying Burning to enemies spreads to to anyone nearby. Including yourself.
notes: On proc, a small orange particle will trail between the burning target you hit and other targets nearby, setting them on fire.
Agitating Spark bypasses block and parry.
Agitating Spark procs caused by self damage will not apply burn. Flame Within is an exception to this.
Has a 1 second cooldown.
Can spread to allies. The Controlled Combustion Talent will prevent Agitating Spark spreading burn to yourself and your allies.

name: Immolation
description: Fire spells cost 70% less while on fire. If you hit someone while on fire, apply fire damage. You take 50% less damage from self-inflicted flames. (+8 Sanity)
notes: "Self-Inflicted flames" include Flame Within, Agitating Spark you spread and environmental burns created by you.
"Apply fire damage" applies the burn status effect instead of adding Flamecharm damage. It also applies burn even if you have Eruption Path: Lava Serpent.

Not all attacks proc this effect, unlike what the Talent description implies. Instead, all instances of Physical damage apply burn, even if the attack doesn't deal pure Physical damage (e.g. Clutching Shadow or Metal Eruption). And all attacks that have the slash (blood particle) vfx on hit like Ice Daggers or Gale Lunge will also proc Immolation, applying burn.

name: Phoenix Flames
description: Any time you would burn to death, you instead rise again with 50% of your health restored. Has a 60 second cooldown.
notes: Healing scales on your Flamecharm investment; heals 25% health at 0 Flamecharm and scales up to 50% health at 75 Flamecharm, gaining 0.33% healing per point in Flamecharm.
If you used Flame Within while knocked to proc Phoenix Flames, then the healing received will be halved. Though, if you activated Flame Within prior to being knocked, you'll receive the full healing.

name: Corpse Explosion
description: Your flames will incinerate unconscious Targets much faster and bodies that you burn to death immediately explode dealing massive damage.
notes: Burn grip unconscious targets, even yourself, in 3.5 seconds instead of 7.
The time it takes for burn to execute is very reliant on server performance, it may take longer than what is listed here.
The explosion does not work; you'll burn them to death without an explosion.

name: Pleeksty's Faith
description: When on fire, automatically quench flames at the cost of some ether.
notes: Does not proc with flames produced by the user with Flame Within or Agitating Spark.
Is also a requirement to fight Aska in Firfire. Without either this Talent, Pleeksty's Will, or the Flame Worshipper Armor you will wipe through his flames.

name: Simmerbloom
description: Basic Attacks on Pleeksty's Inferno are now granted flames.
notes: Pleeksty's Inferno Basic Attacks now apply burn/eruptions. This has no cooldown.
Due to this equipment Talent, Pleeksty Inferno users can save a few, otherwise necessary, talents like Flaming Flourish.
Obtained from Simmerbloom Diadem
Requirements for Equipment: Power 10, 80 Flamecharm

name: Ad Astra
description: Return Home
notes: Grants a Talent tool that teleports you to The Floating Keep on use.
Using it while inside of the Floating Keep will take you back to where you initially used it.

name: Chitin
description: You have a layer of Natural Armor that replenishes when you rest.
notes: Grants 5% damage reduction in the form of Natural Armor.
Chitin has 215 durability at power 1, scaling up to 500 durability at power 20.
Chitin's damage reduction stacks multiplicatively with the Exoskeleton Talent, granting 14.5% damage reduction assuming you have at least 40 Fortitude.
Having both Exoskeleton and Chitin will cause Exoskeleton's durability to take priority, with +200 flat durability added on top, leading to 800 total durability at power 20.
Natural Armor regenerates while resting at a campfire at a rate of 2.2% per 0.2s, aka 11% per second.
Natural Armors are affected by PEN, but its effectiveness is reduced by 75%. (i.e. if someone has 100% PEN, your Natural Armor will resist 7.5% of their damage instead of nothing.)
Natural Armor will lose durability if you get hit by any attack, even if it doesn't resist it.

Natural Armor loss is based on scaled damage received and cannot normally be increased nor decreased by anything, with the exception being damage reductions, like Reinforce, which will reduce the Natural Armor loss.

name: Deepfolk
description: The secrets of the Deep are easier for you to unravel. Your mind is sturdier against its effects, as well as using less Knowledge in Knowledge exchanges.
notes: 1.2x Sanity gain multiplier. You require 1 less Knowledge when making deals with Deep Shrines (Knowledge cost can't go below 1).

name: Feathered Glider
description: As a show of independence when they come of age, Tirans will strike out on their own with just their hand-crated glider, gliding down from the mountain peaks where they make their homes. You take 10% less fall damage.
notes: Tirans gain Feathered Glider, a Glider with infinite durability. The glider changes color depending on the Aspect variant, and can be dyed.

When using the Glider hotkey, regular and Sharkscale Gliders will take priority over the Feathered Glider. You must use all of the durability in your other Gliders if you want to deploy the Feathered Glider with the hotkey.

name: Echolocator
description: Your highly tuned hearing helps you navigate, seeing better in the dark and sensing potential threats.
notes: Pings the location of nearby players who unsheathe their weapons (even through Tacet and Lowstride) and event spawns.

name: Loyalty
description: Your bond with your allies is strong enough to reduce damage between you.
notes: Allies take 35% less damage from you and deal 35% less damage to you. This can stack with the Give and Take Talent, totaling to 48% damage reduction.
This does not apply to self damage.

name: Mark of Jurik

attributes.name: Jurik and Hallowtide Capra Variants Exclusive

description: Mark of Jurik, the Moonseye. A beacon of calm, those in your presence are resistant to insanity.
notes: Gain a tool that lowers the sanity drain of nearby players. Also buffs effected players' HP regen and slightly buffs their food & thirst replenishment from consuming food and their blood regen. 4m CD.
These buffs last 1 minute, the HP regen is 15% of their total HP over that one minute period, healing 0.25% HP per second.
Also buffs non allies. Does not require you to be resting at a campfire.

name: Mark of Ku
description: Mark of Ku, the Mother. Improves the rest of those in your presence.
notes: Gain a tool that buffs the blood regen of nearby players. Also buffs the effected players' HP regen and slightly buffs their sanity and their food & thirst replenishment from consuming food. 3m 30s CD.
These buffs last 1 minute, the HP regen is 15% of their total HP over that one minute period, healing 0.25% HP per second.
Also buffs non allies. Can only be used while you are resting on a campfire.

name: Mark of Nemit
description: Mark of Nemit, the First Beast. Food consumed in your presence is more nourishing.
notes: Gain a tool that buffs the food and thirst replenishment of nearby players. Also buffs the effected players' HP regen and slightly buffs their blood regen and sanity. 3m 30s CD.
These buffs last 1 minute, the HP regen is 15% of their total HP over that one minute period, healing 0.25% HP per second.
Also buffs non allies. Can only be used while you are resting on a campfire.

name: Maudet
description: Your understanding of your destiny is such that learning new things often comes naturally to you. People appreciate your diplomatic ways of speaking.
notes: Passively obtain the benefits of the Autodidact Boon, gaining 3 Free Training Attribute points to spend every level. This effect stacks with the Boon in question.
Increases reputation gain with factions.

name: Molt
description: Ailments and blessings alike fade away more quickly.
notes: Status effects, good or bad, have a shorter duration.
Only works on Chilled, Potions, and Suffocation.

name: Mothwing Dust
description: You release Mothwing Dust when others are the first to strike, granting you vision of your attacker. Your antennae improve your peripheral senses, narrowing the angle at which you can be backstabbed.
notes: When you are hit at the start of combat, the player who hit you will be highlighted with a translucent red outline. This effect lasts 10 seconds.
The angle at which you can be backstabbed is reduced heavily.

name: Navae's Guidance
description: Navae's star guides your path, showing you the way forward. Right-clicking on maps sets a Waymarker which can be followed. You are less prone to starvation.
notes: Receive a compass, displayed at the top of your screen, which points East.

Right clicking on the map will place a waypoint both in the physical world and on the map itself. If you already have a waymarker placed, right clicking on the map will change its location instead of placing a new one.
Lower the passive hunger decay.
If you have the Blind flaw, gain an area of vision around your character.

name: Nightchild
description: Relying on your instincts, you are naturally more stealthy. You are more nimble on wooden surfaces.
notes: Start with 20% more stealth and gain a 1.2x stealth gain multiplier.
This Stealth gain multiplier does not apply to Stealth gained from Crouching, , Tacet, or .
This Stealth multiplier affects the Obvious Flaw, reducing your Stealth by 24%. With the innate Stealth Felinor has, this will result in a net -4% Stealth on spawn.
Gain bonus agility when climbing on all kind of surfaces, not only wooden ones.

name: Seaborne
description: You have a keen understanding of ships and their maintenance.
notes: Ships cost 20% less Notes, turn 20% faster, and have 10% more health.

name: Teachings of the Edenkite
description: Find your centre.
notes: Allows you to meditate, emitting a white aura and causing two white orbs to circle your head. Very heavily reduces your hunger and thirst consumption while you passively gain EXP and Attribute EXP and regenerate health at a mediocre rate, which is slightly reduced when in combat.

name: Versatile
description: You learn how to use new pieces of equipment quicker than others. You can equip things at 3 points lower than the requirement.
notes: This does not work on Power requirements.
This works for both Equipment and Weapon requirements.

Versatile lowers all requirements on things with more than one, so a 72 Galebreathe 37 Medium Weapon Curved Blade of Winds would be possible on a Khan for example. Additionally, Versatile stacks with Silentheart's Weapon stat requirement reduction.

name: Critical Engine
description: You gain the ability to use Deep Gems on your critical attack. Hold out the Deep Gem you wish to apply to your crit then use the tool to enhance your critical.
notes: Equipping a Deep Gem to your critical will not consume the Deep Gem.
Proccing this Talent will put the respective Deep Gem on cooldown if it has one.
Mantle of Enmity can proc Critical Engine. If you use a Blessed Gem, your Mantle aerial attack will halve your critical cooldown rather than your Mantle's.
Aegis Gem grants you 10% damage reduction for 10 seconds on hit.
Blessed Gem halves your critical cooldown on hit.
Warmaster's Medallion critical cooldown reduction is applied before this effect, allowing for a 60% (55% in Chime of Conflict) reduction in critical cooldown overall.
Bloodless Gem Reduces your critical damage by 20%, but grants healing equal to 30% of the damage dealt.

Blue Gem grants you Ether back on hit. The Ether restoration is 1:1 with scaled damage dealt; it cannot be increased nor decreased through modifiers or resistances. This effect does not have PvE scaling.
Insignia Gem reduces the windup of your next Mantra cast by 15% on hit.
Might Gem increases the posture damage of your critical by 10%.
The posture damage bonus can be increased with the Ascended Outlaw Hat Talent, scaling on how many Might Gems you have equipped on your Mantras.
Warped Blue Gem grants the Etherguard status effect on hit if you are wearing the Bluestone Set.
Wayward Gem teleports you to your opponent after landing your critical. There is a 1 second delay between you landing your critical and teleporting.
Wind Gem gives you a speed boost for 8 seconds on hit.

Wrath Gem applies the Wrath status effect for 9 seconds, increasing your critical damage by 7.5% per player combat tag you have. This damage bonus does not apply to the hit that procced Wrath Gem and is affected by the damage modifier cap. Additionally, this can be used to proc the Reinforced War Set Talents.
Nocturnal Gem will deal an additional 10 slash damage after a 1 second delay.

name: Backstabber
description: Landing a backhit with a light attack causes you to grab your opponent and stab them again, dealing an extra 15 damage.

prerequisites.prereqValue: Promotion reward from the Authority Ensign Origin

notes: Procs on M1s, Silentheart abilities, and criticals with the M1 tag.
This Talent does not have a range limit.
Applies daze and ragdolls.

name: Executioner's Frenzy
description: Landing a light attack while your opponent's posture is paused reduces their assassination cooldown by 5 seconds.

prerequisites.prereqValue: Promotion reward from the Authority Ensign Origin

notes: The status effect comes from Stature Break and Maiming Claws.

name: Fatal Stealth
description: You deal increased backstab damage to opponents based on how high your stealth stat currently is.

prerequisites.prereqValue: Promotion reward from the Authority Ensign Origin

notes: Grants +0.2% damage per 1 Stealth to attacks that hit your opponent's back. This affects all damage sources that can receive damage modifiers.
Stealth that is not gained from Equipment or Outfit sources do not count towards this Talent.
Strangely, the Obvious Flaw is an exception to this, reducing your backhit damage by 4%.

The following Stealth sources do not apply to this Talent's damage buff: Felinor's innate Stealth and its Stealth gain multiplier, Agility investment, Crouching, Lowstrude, Murmur: Tacet, and Tacet Minimization.
This does not buff assassinations.
See the Stealth page for info on where stealth can be obtained.
The maximum Stealth you can gain from Equipment alone is 30% (+6% damage).
Notably the Inquisition Light Outfit grants 50% Stealth (+10% damage).

name: Flanking Maneuvers
description: Enemies you assassinate take more PEN from your squadmates in your party.

prerequisites.prereqValue: Promotion reward from the Authority Ensign Origin

name: Stature Break
description: Landing a backstab of any kind disables posture for 8 seconds.

prerequisites.prereqValue: Promotion reward from the Authority Ensign Origin

notes: This applies the Status effect, denying most sources of Posture restoration.
During Paused Posture, you cannot restore posture by: passive posture regen, Parrying, or the Talent. All other forms of posture restoration entirely ignore this status effect.

name: Tacet Minimization
description: Focus your Tacet even further, allowing the radius at which you get spotted to become smaller temporarily.

prerequisites.prereqValue: Promotion reward from the Authority Ensign Origin

notes: Decreases your Tacet bubble size to the minimum possible and grants 400% flat Stealth for 10 seconds. 1 minute cooldown.
Requires maximum Ether to use, even though it does not consume Ether.
Tacet gained by obtaining Soulbreaker does not count for this Talent's obtainment.

name: Ironsing Unbounded
description: You have gained the ability to surpass your limits and train your Ironsing to its fullest. (+10 Health)

name: Ironsinger
description: Grants you the ability to command Metal as an Ironsinger. Press to Pull on Metal Rods.
notes: Ironsing mantras apply stacks of Metal Rods on targets. Pressing will pull affected towards you, with the strength of the pull depending on the amount of Metal Rods present.
You cannot apply more than 5 Metal Rods to one target, unless you have one of the Rending Needle Talents.
Rod pull's keybind can be configured in settings.
Obtained at 1 Ironsing

name: Adept Ironsinger
description: You can now obtain 1-star Ironsinger mantras.
notes: Obtained at 20 Ironsing

name: Expert Ironsinger
description: You can now obtain 2-star Ironsinger mantras.
notes: Obtained at 30 Ironsing

name: Master Ironsinger
description: You can now obtain 3-star Ironsinger mantras. (+5 Health)
notes: Obtained at 50 Ironsing

name: Alloyblood
description: You don't bleed like others do. Bleed damage reduced by 30%. Blood loss is reduced by 75%.
notes: While at 100 Ironsing, bleed damage is reduced from 15% scaled damage to 10.5%. Bleed from is reduced from 7.5% scaled damage to 5.25%.

description: Gain more parry frames the lower your health is.
notes: Prerequisitses: Using Rapier, 50 Light Weapon

description: Running attacks deal increased posture damage. Upon landing your Critical, your next running attack will have increased range.
notes: Running attack with rapiers deal 35% more posture damage.

notes: Increase blood bar damage by 50%.

name: Lightspeed Reflexes
description: Feinting gives a very brief auto-parry window. (+1 Passive Agility)
notes: Grants 0.15s of auto-parry frames.

notes: Allows you to reflect the entirety of multi-hit moves (such as Enforcer's spin attack)

description: Guardbreaking an opponent causes them to take extra thunder damage and applies Electrify for 7 seconds.

prerequisites.prereqValue: Promotion reward from the Authority Ensign Origin

notes: Deals 15 Thundercall damage.
The Electrify status effect changes your opponent's damage type to Thundercall and gives you 10% damage reduction to their attacks.

name: Martial Brutality
description: The less health your opponent has, the more posture damage you deal to them.

prerequisites.prereqValue: Promotion reward from the Authority Ensign Origin

notes: Increases your posture damage by 0.1% per 1% health missing, up to a maximum of +10% posture damage against someone at 0% health.

description: Landing enough lightning mantras without getting hit grants you a defensive lightning cloak for 15 seconds, letting you negate damage from light attacks and ironsing.

description: Crimes you commit in allied territories are often ignored. Who's asking?
notes: Guards from faction which you are at or above neutral reputation will not aggro on you.
Crimes still induce reputation loss however, guards will turn hostile/react to crimes when your reputation becomes negative.

description: Chance to receive two sets of ore when mining, mine ores a lot faster.

notes: The Miner's Hardhat has this Talent.

description: Chance to receive two sets of ingredients when harvesting.

name: Celebrity
description: Your natural skill in mediating conflict makes people think more highly of you. Your base reputation with factions is higher and your reputation caps out higher.
notes: This Talent was merged with the old "Diplomat" Talent.

name: Under The Radar
description: The negative reputation threshold for a faction to put out posters of you is now higher. (+1 health)
notes: If it is stacked with the "Celebrity" Talent you can immediately avoid being hunted by Voidwalkers until you lose one of the two Talents or continue to have a very bad reputation with The Knives of Eylis or some other faction.

name: You'll Need To Get Past Me
description: When you're attacked, one of your many allies will leap into action to protect their boss.
notes: Spawns in an NPC to attack whoever hits you. The 3 known NPCs are Bandits, Bandit Leaders, or Bounty Hunters.
The cooldown of this Talent scales on your Charisma investment, having a base cooldown of 69.286 seconds and every investment point into Charisma decreasing this by 0.143 seconds.

The spawned NPC applies a player combat tag on hit.
Note that an ally appearing with the Talent only works with players and is scaled by the level of the attacking enemy.

The ally will perform just like a normal NPC
You'll Need to Get Past Me can only proc when hit while outside of combat.
The NPC can drop their weapon on death.

name: Going Nowhere
description: When enemies dodge your attacks, their momentum is killed and they're briefly prevented from sprinting. (+6 Passive Agility)
notes: When an enemy dodges your attack, halts their momentum and disables their ability to sprint for 1 second.

name: Volcanic Glass
description: Detonating crystals causes an eruption soon after.

name: Hungry Flames
description: When you have no Ether, consume Stomach and Water to instantly cast your next fire mantra.
notes: 15 second cooldown.

name: Blood Bag
description: You receive extra blood from knocking an enemy.

name: Blood Transfusion
description: Successfully landing a critical attack while under a negative status effect will transfer the effect plus recover a small portion of your blood bar.
notes: 20 second cooldown.

description: First Bloodrend mantra you hit in combat has increased blood drain.
notes: Currently does not work.

description: Guardbreaking enemies leaves enemies more susceptible to blood loss from Bloodrend mantras.

description: Deal 5% more damage to factions that despise you. Serves them right.

name: Kj's Courage
description: Gain 10% more Knowledge from all sources, rounded down.
notes: This will only impact you if you gain 10 or more Knowledge in one instance.

name: Nanji's Training
description: Nanji shows you a better way to properly block attacks using a weapon, granting you 1 Posture. (+1 Posture)

name: Supernatural Sense
description: After dealing with real actual literal ghosts, you feel emboldened. (+10 Sanity)

name: Bulldozer
description: Enemies you flourish into a wall have a chance of breaking the wall and are guard broken on impact.
notes: This has a 50% chance to break destructible objects when you flourish people into them.

name: Broken Ankles
description: Blockbreaking an opponent puts their Mobility slot Mantras on CD for 12s.
notes: 30 second cooldown.
Broken Ankles' duration will be reduced by 0.15 seconds for every point in Strength below 70, capping at 8.25 seconds with 45 Strength.

name: Piercing Blow
description: Attacks that break an opponent's block ignore their Armor resistances.
notes: If you do not have 100 Strength, this Talent will instead halve your opponent's armor resistances multiplicatively, before PEN on proc.

description: Blunt damage now fully ignores the posture bonus from shields. (+1 Posture)
notes: Bypass the increased posture from your enemies shield. Effectively, your enemy is stripped from their shield.

description: Getting parried punishes your posture 33% less. (+2 Posture)

description: Gain 5% extra PEN and remove the cap on your PEN. Go beyond your limits.
notes: The additional 5% PEN scales with your Strength, only granting the full +5% PEN at 90 Strength.

Mutual Exclusive: Ether Overdrive

name: Jolting Current
description: Your lightning attacks in water strike others near them with lightning.
notes: While you and your opponent are in the water, landing any attack that would apply Shock or a Surge Rod will strike other waterborne targets in a 20 stud AoE from the initial target, dealing 50% of the attack's damage and applying Shock or a Surge Rod.

name: Rending Needle: Augmenter
description: If an enemy has 5 or more rods, your Ironsing Pull will use their rods to form a powerful sword to attack with. This also makes your Metal Armament stronger while the weapon is equipped.
notes: Equips the Metal Greatsword weapon on proc.
Having Metal Greatsword equipped increases your Metal Armament damage by 50%.
Metal Greatsword lasts 10 seconds before reverting to your original weapon.
Maximum amount of Iron Rods you can apply to a single target is 5.
Mutual Exclusives: Rending Needle: Conductor, Rending Needle: Impaler, Rending Needle: Jailer, Gilded Path: Scrapsinger

name: Rending Needle: Conductor
description: 5 metal rods will combine into a conductor rod. If an enemy uses a non-Ironsing elemental mantra, they're dealt with their element back in return.
notes: Works as default path with exception of applying a Conductor rod after 5 normal metal rods are applied.
Conductor rods last 30 seconds or until an elemental mantra is used.
On proc, the Conductor Rod will apply the elemental effect of the Mantra your opponent is trying to use to themselves.
If your opponent uses a Mantra while being affected by a Conductor rod, 5% of their current armor durability will be drained and it proc have the following effect:
Flamecharm Mantra: Apply Burn (base path) / No effect with Eruption path, rod falls off.
Frostdraw Mantra: Deals a very low amount of damage (Base path) / Apply Crystal on victim (Crystallization path)
Galebreathe Mantra: Suffocate + Cancels mantra (Base path) / Spawn Apparition (Specter Path)
Shadowcast Mantra: Doubles the Ether cost of the Mantra cast
Thundercall Mantra: Applies Shock + Cancels mantra (Base path) / Applies Surge stack (Surge path)
Attunement-less/Ironsing/Bloodrend/Oath Mantra: The rod does not fall off, but their armor is still drained till conductor rod expires.
You can't pull out Conductor rods, nor can they be consumed with Scrapsinger.
Conductor's rod on proc doesn't apply pull immunity.
Mutual Exclusives: Rending Needle: Augmenter, Rending Needle: Impaler, Rending Needle: Jailer

name: Conductor's Cable
description: Applying Conductor rods on opponents steals some of their armor to you.
notes: Steals 10% of your enemy's maximum armor durability on proc.

name: Rending Needle: Impaler
description: If an enemy is affected by 5 or more metal rods, your Ironsing Pull instead pulls out all of the rods for massive damage.
notes: Increases the maximum amount of iron rods you can apply to a single target from 5 to 10.
Has a base damage of 4 physical damage per rod, with 5 Ironsing scaling.

Deals 5.5 physical damage per rod at 75 Ironsing.
Affected by most damage modifiers.
Innately has 0% PEN.
Has 6.5x PvE multiplier.
Mutual Exclusives: Rending Needle: Augmenter, Rending Needle: Conductor, Rending Needle: Jailer

name: Rending Needle: Jailer
description: If an enemy has 5 or more rods, your Ironsing Pull will restrain them instead of pulling them.
notes: Increases the maximum amount of iron rods you can apply to a single target from 5 to 10.
When affected by Jailer, the victim will be unable to do anything except Vent.
The victim is given 30% damage reduction when Jailed.
When Jailed, the victim will have a 6 second rod and pull immunity. When Jailer expires, their rod pull immunity will be automatically reduced down to 1 second.
Jailer's duration scales on the amount of rods applied, having a 1.08s duration at 5 rods, and gaining 0.104 seconds per rod after 5. This caps at a 1.6s duration with 10 rods.
Mutual Exclusives: Rending Needle: Augmenter, Rending Needle: Impaler, Rending Needle: Conductor

name: Family Recipe
description: You can now craft bombs at a crafting bench.
notes: Iron Bombs are crafted with 2 Iron and 1 Coal at any crafting bench.
Bombs have a base damage of 10, scaling on Intelligence. At 100 Intelligence, they deal 45.5 damage.
Bombs deal typeless damage, ignoring armor resistances.
Press while holding a bomb to throw it. Press while holding a bomb to drop it at your feet.
Bombs do not deal self damage.
Bombs have a 5 second cooldown on throw.
It is highly recommended that you use the Miner's Hardhat when farming for the crafting materials, as it doubles your mining output with a chance to quadruple it.

name: Incendiary Formula
description: Bombs will set your enemies on fire upon detonation, as well as launch with more force. Bombs will deal 20% increased damage to burning enemies.
notes: Bombs apply burn on hit. This burn, like all other burn scales on your Flamecharm investment and can be improved through the usage of Flamecharm Talents.
Your bombs go further when thrown.

description: Your cooldown for throwing bombs will be shortened after your first bomb damages an enemy.
notes: Reduces the bomb throw cooldown from 5 seconds to 4 seconds. This only applies to the bomb thrown directly after this Talent procs, not on the bomb that procced this Talent.
20 second cooldown.

name: Hot Potato
description: Gain a large boost of speed after throwing a bomb. Your bombs have a chance to detonate twice. (+6 Passive Agility)
notes: This speed boost lasts 2 seconds.

description: Crafting a bomb will yield two bombs. Chance to make three.

description: You have a chance to activate a bomb in your inventory when damaged. (+1 Health, +5 Carry Load)
notes: On proc, this consumes 1 Iron Bomb to drop 2 bombs at your feet.
Has a 1 second cooldown that will activate upon taking damage, even if the Talent does not proc and even if you do not have Iron Bombs in your inventory.

name: Chorus of Souls
description: Alone, the Wisps lack a voice. But surrounded by so many, the frequencies overlap and you hear it true. (+1 Wisp Mantra Slot)
notes: Grants heavily increased health regeneration if you have all Wisps active.
This will not proc unless you have every Wisp Mantra equipped and active. If one of your Wisps runs out, this Talent will deactivate until you recast the Wisp.
This Talent will not work if you do not have the Oathless Oath.

description: Your mastery over the Wisps of the Song enables you to mediate the innate conflicts between your wisps, allowing any number of Wisps to be active at a time. (+1 Wisp Mantra slot)
notes: Allows the player to summon one of each Wisp at the same time.

name: Wisp Convergence
description: When empowered by the Chorus, your Wisps now grant their elements to your strikes.
notes: This will not proc unless you have every Wisp Mantra equipped and active. If one of your Wisps runs out, this Talent will deactivate until you recast the Wisp.
Your basic attacks will apply Burn, Shock, Chill, Winded, Shadow, Metal Rods, and Blood Poison all at once.
This Talent will not work if you do not have the Oathless Oath.

description: You have gained the ability to surpass your limits and train your Heavy Weapons attribute to its fullest.

description: You have gained the ability to surpass your limits and train your Light Weapons attribute to its fullest.

description: You have gained the ability to surpass your limits and train your Medium Weapons attribute to its fullest.

description: All of your Elemental Mantras below Lv. 5 are now 1 level higher. Your Mantras are now converted to the element of your current stance.

notes: Hero's Assist summons the past heroes of the attunements themselves to aid you in battle. You can spawn heroes independent of your current Saint Stance.

Flamecharm: Upon flourishing an enemy, set down 3 deadly eruptions in the direction of the flourish, each of which innately proc the talent .

Thundercall: Upon casting a mantra for the first time, your mantra cast will have much higher windup and damage.
The damage buff is currently bugged and does not work, meaning this does nothing but nerf your mantra.

notes: Allows you to fully negate the damage of one attack that has a damage type that corresponds with your current Saint Stance.

description: After a full rotation of stances your elemental scaling is increased by 15% and Mantra Modifiers increased by 10%.

the Obelisk will consume 10 Knowledge and instantly fully progress your Oath (can only be done if you've previously fully progressed Saintsworn).

Acts similarly to Songchant in the sense that it increases the effectiveness of your investment.
Turns your Saintsblade and the Saintsworn Oath cosmetic (the swords on your back) white on proc.

name: Saint's Synergy
description: 15% of your highest element scaling is applied to other elemental damage.

prerequisites.prereqValue: speak to any Attunement Obelisk while having at least
the Obelisk will consume 10 Knowledge and instantly fully progress your Oath (can only be done if you've previously fully progressed Saintsworn).

notes: 15% of the investment scaling from your highest Attuned stat is added to your other Attuned Mantras, granting them slight dual scaling.

name: Perpetual Distillery
description: Your very body has become a distillery for your alchemy. Gain 3 Autobrew slots that will automatically produce 3 concoctions of your choice.
notes: Upon clicking the Distillery Talent, you're given three empty spaces where you input your potions. You're able to switch the mode from "Throw" to "Drink", and vice versa. Upon clicking on a key you'll automatically drink or throw the potion in that slot. Some potions are unable to be slotted.

The potions within the Distillery are infinite, and are used within their directed cooldowns. This allows builds to be able to use up to three individual potions without the lackluster windup and cooldown in the throwing and drinking process.
Drink potions place other drink slots on a cooldown if they share buffs.
When replacing a potion in the Distillery, the one that was previously there is voided. Potions cannot be recovered once placed in the Distillery.
Potions in the distillery will scale their potency to the Salchemist's current Intelligence investment, even if they were made with higher/lower Intelligence.
Upon casting Lethal Injection, all potions in your Distillery will be used at once unless they're on cooldown.

name: Antithetic Salts
description: Alter your brews to invert their effects. Does not count towards the ingredient limit.

prerequisites.prereqValue: speak to Adrofalis and spend to instantly skip the Oath's progression (this can only be done if you've fully progressed Saltchemist before).

notes: Gives you a Talent tool-like ability that acts as a potion ingredient on use.
When applied to your potions, it inverts the effects of the ingredients in the potion. For example, 3 Urchins and 2 Goblettos would restore sanity, lower health regen, and slightly increase speed.
The name of the potion will change to fit its new effect. The color can change, but this is inconsistent.
Oath Skipping Saltchemist is generally not recommended due to how easy it is to get the materials needed for the craft.

name: Aromatic Salts
description: Alter your brews to create lingering clouds of mist on shattering. Does not count towards the ingredient limit.

prerequisites.prereqValue: speak to Adrofalis and spend to instantly skip the Oath's progression (this can only be done if you've fully progressed Saltchemist before).

notes: Gives you a Talent tool-like ability that acts as a potion ingredient on use.
Each "hit" of the mist count as a potion application, triggering the enhanced potion effects from Chain Reaction.
Lasts for roughly 10 seconds.
Ingredients that alter a potion's duration such as Redds and Spider Eggs do not affect the lingering clouds.
Oath Skipping Saltchemist is generally not recommended due to how easy it is to get the materials needed for the craft.

name: Biotic Salts
description: Alter your brews to not provide their positive effects to your enemies. Does not count towards the ingredient limit.

prerequisites.prereqValue: speak to Adrofalis and spend to instantly skip the Oath's progression (this can only be done if you've fully progressed Saltchemist before).

notes: Gives you a Talent tool-like ability that acts as a potion ingredient on use.
Biotic Salts half negative effects of potions for allies, and positive effects for enemies.
This should be used in every potion possible, as it has no downsides whatsoever.

Due to how potions work, even your negative potions may have some positive effects and vice versa; this Talent is very good for diminishing those unwanted effects to basically nothing without any downsides.
Biotic Salts count yourself as an ally.
Oath Skipping Saltchemist is generally not recommended due to how easy it is to get the materials needed for the craft.

name: Enhanced Flow
description: Refine your Rush Hour, allowing you to now also gain temp health whenever you hit a player while using Rush Hour. You now also take less damage from Rush Hour.
notes: When you land basic attacks during , gain Temporary Health equal to 30% of your weapon's scaled damage.

description: Landing a critical on opponents applies 15 seconds of Torture Mastery. Heal any chip damage off players who have Torture Mastery on them. This duration is doubled if you have Rush Hour on.
notes: On proc, all chip damage you deal will be converted into healing.
The conversion of chip damage to healing is 1:1.

name: Dark Receiver
description: Shadow moves will also steal Ether from those you are Static Linked tethered to.
notes: Deal 4.5x Ether steal against linked targets. Additionally, drain Ether from all linked targets equally when landing Shadowcast moves.

name: Blood Bank
description: Consuming 'Charm' now gives slight temporary health.
notes: Procs when you proc Donation Drive or Manipulator.
Grants 25 flat temporary health.

name: Donation Drive
description: Consuming 'Charm' on an opponent replenishes some blood. Additionally, you can also activate this effect and Manipulator through blockbreaking with a Bloodrend mantra.
notes: Donation Drive's cooldown scales on your Charisma investment, having an 8 second cooldown at 60 Charisma and gaining 0.1s for every point in Charisma below 60.
Donation Drive has a 8.5 second cooldown at 55 Charisma, and a maximum cooldown of 10.5 seconds at 35 Charisma.

name: Sharing is Caring
description: Your 'Charm' on opponents also slightly increases your blood drain against them.

name: Windwaker
description: Call upon a gust of wind to propel your boat even faster.
notes: The ability can be used as long as the player is standing on a boat, even if not in control.
Сannot be used in combat.

description: Enemies hit after you feint them with your fist suffer slight bleed and have their vision obscured slightly and makes PvE enemies Sluggish. (+1 Passive Agility)
notes: 8 second cooldown.

name: Pocket Sand
description: Feinting into an uppercut blinds, applies Stagger to PvE enemies and also applies Dazed briefly. We're even now, right?
notes: 30 second cooldown.
Procs through Block/Parry/Dodge, and applies to all uppercut mantras (ex: Rising Flame).
The Stagger status effect makes your opponent take 33% more posture damage.

notes: Your Ironsing Mantras/abilities, Ironsing legendary weapons, and Metal Rods are now yellow.
Mutual Exclusive: Rending Needle: Augmenter

notes: Each Artisan Blade has 8 Base damage with 5 Ironsing scaling; simplified formula as follows: 8 + 0.04 * Ironsing investment. They deal 4.5 posture damage each if blocked. Their damage cannot be modified.

Artisan's blade have windup of 1.2s.
Parrying Artisan's blade gives brief Auto Parry frames.
Pulling rods normally also procs this Talent.

description: Successful hits from Artisan's Blades will proc metal rods and deal 50% more damage.
notes: Increases Artisan's Blades damage by 1.5x, additionally Artisan's Blades will apply 1 rod per each hit.
