notes: Grants a Talent tool that can only be used in the Voidheart.
After picking up a bounty, you can use this tool to select your bounty hunt method; stealth or ferocity.
Stealth: Teleport near, but far away from your target. The bounty indication will be hidden.
Ferocity: Teleport close to your target, highlighting them through walls briefly. Your character will be enveloped in shadows, signifying that you have a bounty.
Grasp of Eylis can only be used on bounties targets that are less than 4 levels lower than you.
You cannot use Chime of Dwelling while on a bounty hunt.

name: Voideye
description: Voidmother's blessing, the method to travel back to the Voidheart.
notes: Grants a Talent tool that teleports you back to the Voidheart on use.
Has a short animation that can be interrupted.
1 minute cooldown.

name: Voidwalker Contract
description: You progress much faster from completing bounties, and less from events. Gain access to the Voidheart, and factions have a negative outlook on you.
notes: Gain increased EXP from bounties of all kinds, but gain reduced EXP from all other sources.

name: Last Second Negotiations
description: Most enemies will hesitate a moment longer to execute you.
notes: Whenever you are getting gripped, your character will say "WAIT WAIT WAIT WAIT!!!", which has a chance to automatically cancel the grip attempt, forcing the target to attempt a grip again. This also slightly slows down the grip attempt.
Does not work in PVE.

name: Cap Artist
description: Pressing [] while crouching allows you to fake being dead. You also take a bit less damage from PvE while ragdolled as well. (+2 Passive Agility)
notes: Your eyes are still open, your name is still visible and you do not leave a loot bag.
Cap Artist's activation keybind can be configured in settings.
Cancelled by pressing the activation key again.
Using Cap artist in the depths makes you have normal gravity.
Disabled with Brick Wall.
The Tillian's Beret equipment has this Talent.

name: Pickpocket
description: Gain the ability to pickpocket by pressing . Deal a little more damage the more notes you have against PvE opponents as well. (+2 Passive Agility)
notes: The target needs to be Unconscious to be pickpocket-able.
The Pickpocket keybind can be configured in settings.
Gain +0.0002% PvE damage for every you have. At 15,000 Notes, this provides a 3% damage buff.

name: Master Thief
description: Gain more notes when mugging a player.

name: Another Man's Trash
description: Take unequipped equipment when mugging a player. Gain a little more damage against PvE the more you are currently carrying. (+2 Passive Agility)
notes: If the player you are mugging doesn't have any Notes, you will still take any unequipped equipment.
Does not take enchanted or Soulbound items.
Gain +0.01% PvE damage for every 1 weight in your inventory. Every 100 weight equates to +1% damage.

name: Discharge
description: On 5th successful attack you will discharge static dealing lightning damage to those nearby.
notes: Deals 5 Thundercall damage with 5 Thundercall scaling, gaining 0.025 damage per point in Thundercall.
Applies Shock or 1 Surge Rod on proc.

name: Rain of Static
description: After successfully casting lightning impact, strike down countless thunder at those below. In return your Lightning Impact will require more time to cast.
notes: When casting Lightning Impact, hover above the ground and fire 4 thunder projectiles. Afterward, you strike down normally.

name: Windup Battery
description: Landing 3 Thundercall Mantras without whiffing reduces the windup of your next Mantra by 10%.
notes: Applies this bonus to non-Thundercall Mantras.
Requirement: 30 Thundercall, 30 Intelligence
The old Jolt Cast Talent was reworked into this.

name: Static Blade
description: Hitting blocks, blocking or parrying hits will now generate an electric charge in your blade, granting a small speed buff. Charges can stack up to 5 times.
notes: Grants stacks when you get parried, not when you parry attacks. Also grants stacks when you hit blocks or block attacks.
Each stack lasts for 15 seconds and refresh upon gaining another, including when you're at max stacks. You can be at max stacks indefinitely.

Each stack grants an ~2.35% speed boost, totaling to ~11.75% speed at max stacks. The duration of this speed boost is effectively indefinite, as gaining stacks can be done very easily just by playing the game.
This speed boost can proc speed boost Talents, like or .

name: Gathering Electricity
description: Reaching 5 Static Blade charges will now consume the stacks and apply a lightning buff to your blade. 60 second cooldown.
notes: Clears all Static Blade stacks on proc.
You can still gain Static Blade stacks while Gathering Electricity is active.
For 15 seconds, this increases the base damage on your weapon attacks, including criticals by 3.
+3 base damage might not seem like a large buff, but due to how Deepwoken's damage calculation works, this is very significant.

name: Overcharge
description: Your next dash after activating Static Blade is enhanced by lightning.
notes: Lightning Dashes increase your dash distance travelled by 2.3x and the duration of i-frames from rolling, but will end early if you attack.

name: Thundercall Unbounded
description: You have gained the ability to surpass your limits and train your Thundercall to its fullest. (+10 Health)

name: Thundercaller
description: Grants you the ability to command Lightning as a Thundercaller.
notes: Obtained at 1 Thundercall

name: Adept Thundercaller
description: You can now obtain 1-star Thundercaller mantras.
notes: Obtained at 20 Thundercall

name: Expert Thundercaller
description: You can now obtain 2-star Thundercaller mantras.
notes: Obtained at 30 Thundercall

name: Master Thundercaller
description: You can now obtain 3-star Thundercaller mantras. (+5 Health)
notes: Obtained at 50 Thundercall

name: Discovery Of Fire
description: Flints and Flamecharm are for simpletons.
notes: Using this ability will consume 20 Ether to cause a lightning strike that lights nearby entities aflame including campfires, players, and monsters.
Has a 1 second delay between usage and the lightning bolt striking, potentially allowing for movestacks.
15 second cooldown. This cooldown starts when the lightning bolt strikes.
Deals 3 flat Thundercall damage on impact, applying burn with no hitstun and 1.08x PvE scaling.
Discovery of Fire can be parried and blocked, applying parry stun to the caster if parried, and dealing 0 posture damage if blocked.
Does not have hitregistry in Chime of Conflict.

name: Shocking Finish
description: Following a flourish up with a lightning beam causes it to be casted instantly.

name: Static Fakeout
description: Roll cancelling immediately after a parry will cause you to teleport behind your opponent.

name: Static Flash Clone
description: When using lightning clones you instead disappear leaving behind a static clone for a short duration.

name: Stratoshock
description: Your lightning deals an additional +5% damage when in the rain.
notes: Thundercall damage innately gains a 5% damage buff during rain, with Stratoshock increasing this to +10% damage.

name: Manipulator
description: Deal 20% more critical attack damage to charmed enemies, but the effect is removed on impact.
notes: 10 second cooldown.
Works insanely well with Unnecessary Theatrics and Overcharm as they reapply the charm after the charm is removed on the same hit.
Will not allow you to proc Manipulator twice as it has a cooldown.
Tough Love and Manipulator proc at the same time, allowing for a 30% damage bonus.
Manipulator is inherently weaker on multihit criticals, but that doesn't mean it's always bad.
For example, a 5 hit multihit critical will only gain the 20% damage bonus from Manipulator on the first hit as it only procs once and then goes on cooldown.

The effectiveness of Manipulator on multihitting criticals depends entirely on the critical itself, with its hit count and scaled damage multipliers being very important factors, as well as whether or not you expect to even land the whole thing. Sometimes front loading the critical proves more effective than having a more consistently applied damage multiplier.

name: Narcissist
description: Charming an already Charmed opponent Overcharms you briefly. Guess you really were always that great.
notes: Overcharms yourself for 4 seconds.
Charms yourself for 8 seconds (halved to 4s if you have Disbelief).
The self Charm proc reduces self damage taken by 10% and allows you to benefit from Charismatic Cast's secondary effect, which reduces your time knocked by 50%.

Landing M1s and criticals while Overcharmed charms your opponent for 5 seconds (halved to 2.5s if they have Disbelief). Additionally, Overcharm grants a 10% damage bonus to melee attacks when hitting charmed opponents.
Mutual Exclusives: Tough Love

name: Sow and Mend
description: Sacrifice 35% of your blood for temporary health. (30s CD)
notes: Gives 25 flat Temporary Health on use.

name: Cyclical Exsanguination
description: Whenever you deal more than 20 damage to an enemy in an instance, pause your temporary health decay for 3 seconds.
notes: 8 second cooldown.
This can proc on self damage.

name: Embolism
description: If an enemy is guardbroken while you have temporary health, convert your temporary health into additional damage.

name: Hypovolemic Focus
description: While you have temporary health, your opponent regains far less posture from parrying you
notes: The opponent regains 20% less posture damage from parrying you.

name: Cheap Shot
description: Your attacks gain 10% PEN multiplicatively when you have an active speed boost. (+6 Passive Agility)
notes: It multiplies your PEN by 1.1x. IE: if you are at 30% PEN, Cheap Shot will give you an additional 3% PEN.
Cheap Shot cannot bypass the PEN cap.
Cheap Shot's PEN multiplier will be reduced by 0.11% for every point in Agility below 65, having a minimum multiplier of +7.22% PEN (or 1.072x PEN) at 40 Agility.

name: Crippling Comeuppance
description: Landing Revenge puts your opponent's Mobility slot Mantras on CD and applies Sluggish to PvE enemies for 15s. (+1 Passive Agility)
notes: 30 second cooldown.
For every point of Agility below 100, Crippling Comeuppance's duration is reduced by 0.1 seconds, having a minimum duration of 12.5 seconds at 75 Agility.

name: Down Comes the Claw
description: Landing a Critical while you have a speed boost prevents your opponent from being able to dodge twice in a row for 5s. (+1 Passive Agility)
notes: Down Comes the Claw cannot be reapplied while it's currently active.
Lasts 6.5 seconds.
For every point in Agility under 75, Down Comes the Claw loses 0.055 seconds of duration, capping at a minimum of 5.11 seconds with 50 Agility.

name: Maiming Claws
description: Down Comes the Claw now disables your opponent's posture regeneration for 6s on proc. (+1 Passive Agility)
notes: Applies to passive posture regeneration, Steady Nerves, and posture restoration from parrying. All other sources of posture restoration ignore Maiming Claws entirely.
Cannot be reapplied while Down Comes the Claw is currently active.
Maiming Claws' duration will be shortened if you do not meet its requirements.

name: Pursuit
description: If you land your Revenge, clear the cooldown immediately. (25s cooldown) (+1 Passive Agility)
notes: Procs even if Revenge is blocked, parried, dodged, or vented.
For every point in Agility below 90, Pursuit will gain +0.375 seconds to its cooldown, capping at 29.375 seconds with 65 Agility.

name: Face Cutter
description: Your Spine Cutter now deals an additional hit. (+2 Passive Agility)
notes: Grants an additional hit to your Spine Cutter that deals 50% of your weapon's scaled damage.
Similarly to Spine Cutter, the damage this deals cannot be buffed, and the attack has no PEN.

name: Turning of the Wheel
description: After perfect dodging a swing or critical attack, step backwards and ramp up your swingspeed.

name: Wraith Path: Twisted Puppets
description: Your Flamecharm mantras summon puppets of shadow and flame. Your flames are now black.
notes: Turns Hero Blade of Flame, Ysley's Pyre Keeper, Pleeksty's Inferno, Rosen's Hellflame, Blazing, and Railblade's criticals and all Flamecharm mantras black. Additionally, the orange on the Hero Blade of Flame's and Ysley's Pyre Keeper's models change to black. And the orange on Pleeksty's Inferno's model changes to purple.
Twisted Puppets has two different burn types. They both look identical and they both scale on your Flamecharm investment, deal Flamecharm damage, and drain 6.25 Ether per tick from affected players.
Shadow damage from any source applies Shadow Burn. Shadow Burn does 75% less damage than base Flamecharm burn. This burn type cannot be applied to knocked targets.
Anything that would normally apply burn applies Puppet Burn. Puppet Burn does 87.5% less damage than base Flamecharm burn. Puppet Burn allows you to spawn Puppets.
Both these damage multipliers are applied after other damage boosters such as Ash Ember thus working extremely poorly with it.

Puppets deal 20 typeless damage with no innate investment scaling. Because Puppets deal typeless damage, they bypass armor resistances and . They do NOT do True Damage however, as general resistances still work on them.
Puppet damage can be increased with damage modifiers. Additionally, Puppet damage is reduced when it's raining unless you have the Unyielding Inferno Talent.
Puppets deal 10 posture damage.
Puppets spawn whenever Puppet Burn deals damage with a 4 second cooldown.
Increases the uptime of your Flame of Denial by 25%, from 25 seconds to 31.25.
Mutual Exclusives: Eruption Path: Lava Serpent, Azure Flames, Flashboil

name: Burning Puppets
description: Your puppets can now inflict burn and fire-based Talents when they explode.
notes: Grants Puppets 5 Flamecharm scaling, increasing their damage by 0.1 per point in Flamecharm.
Your Puppets will deal 30 damage at 100 Flamecharm with this talent.
Your Puppets apply Puppet burn, allowing you to spawn more Puppets.

name: Burning Sacrifice
description: Sacrifice puppets who have been alive for half of their lifetime and burn purple for Emperor Flame Stacks, a damage boost per puppet, and a slight speed boost.
notes: Gives you a Talent tool that must be actively used to proc this Talent.
Grants +4% basic attack damage and a speed boost per Puppet for 6s. Caps off at +12% damage.
Puppets turn purple after being alive for 15 seconds.
15 second cooldown if at least one Puppet is successfully sacrificed, 1 second cooldown if not.

name: Explosive Rage
description: Causing explosion will make your puppets go into a frenzy - speeding up and dealing 50% more damage.
notes: The buff is signified by an orange swirling aura around your Puppets.
Buffs all currently alive Puppets and all Puppets that spawn within the next 10 seconds.
The damage buff is bugged and does not work.
The following abilities and Talents proc Explosive Rage: Explosive Finish, Emperor Flame, The Final Act, and the Detonation enchant.

name: Moths to a Flame
description: You summon a puppet of black flames that homes onto enemies with black flames.
notes: Your Puppets home onto the closest entity (excluding yourself) who is burning from either of the Twisted Puppets burn types.
This can include allies.
Puppets move significantly faster when they get close to a burning target.

name: Audacity
description: Once you've brought down your prey, instill fear into all those who would separate you from claiming it. Charmed or nearby enemies will fear for longer. Nearby allies gain a 10% damage buff (40s). (+1 Posture)
notes: 25 second cooldown.
Audacity's buff duration will be reduced by 0.1 seconds for every point of Charisma and Strength you are below its requirements, capping at 35 seconds with 75 Charisma and 25 Strength.
You create an AoE stun and slow around you when you start gripping someone.
Makes you immune to Defiant Until the End and Last Second Negotiation when it procs. (Bugged on NPCS)
The damage buff is indicated by a white glowing halo effect surrounding the affected player's head.

name: No Survivors
description: Your allies and yourself execute faster when affected by Overcharm.
notes: Reduces grip time by 0.5 seconds (16.67% faster)

name: Rule Through Fear
description: Executing an enemy applies Overcharm to nearby allies and yourself.
notes: Overcharms for 10 seconds.

Landing M1s and criticals while Overcharmed charms your opponent for 5 seconds (halved to 2.5s if they have Disbelief). Additionally, Overcharm grants a 10% damage bonus to melee attacks when hitting charmed opponents. This bonus does not stack with Tough Love.

name: Denial Repulse
description: You now emit a delayed burst of flames after coming close to death.
notes: When Flame of Denial activates, release an explosion around you.
This explosion deals 20 Flamecharm damage with 5 Flamecharm scaling, adding up to 30 Flamecharm damage at 100 Flamecharm.
This cannot be parried nor dodged, but can be blocked, dealing 5 posture damage.
This has a windup of 0.6 seconds.

name: Undying Flame
description: Your Graceful Flame burns brightly even underwater. Those that gather around it are soothed and regain sanity.
notes: Graceful Flame can now be casted in the First Layer. It cannot be used in the Diluvian Mechanism or Depths Trials, however.
Graceful Flame now passively restores sanity and health to those around it.
Merged with the old Soundness of Mind Talent.

name: Surge Path: Unstable Capacitor
description: Your lightning no longer applies Shock, instead apply Surge. At maximum stacks of Surge, your opponents will Overload, sending arcs of lightning in every direction.
notes: Turns all Thundercall mantras, Jumpstart, Stormseye, Hero Blade of Lightning and Boltcrusher blurple. May affect Arcwarder and Saintsworn in the future.
Each Surge stack lasts 30 seconds.
You need to apply 5 Surge stacks and then land another attack that would apply a Surge stack to cause an Overload.
This is reduced to 4 Surge stacks with the Charged Ring.
Surge Overload deals 2.5 Thundercall damage per Surge stack with 5 Thundercall scaling to Overloaded target.
Surge Overload AoE deals 2 Thundercall damage per Surge stack.
Surge stacks are a global status effect, meaning anyone with Surge path can utilize them, with the effects changing based on who caused the Overload.

name: Battery Sapper
description: If your Human Battery targets have Ether, it will drain their Ether to help pay for your Mantras. 10s cooldown.
notes: This Talent is currently bugged and does nothing.

name: Catalytic Strike
description: Posture breaking an enemy will Overload their Surge stack.

name: Closed Circuit
description: Surge Overloads that fail to arc to other opponents will deal additional damage to the Overloaded enemy.
notes: Adds 5 damage to the Overload with 5 Thundercall scaling.

name: Fried Circuits
description: Overloading an enemy applies Sapped for 5s.
notes: Sapped effect causes the duration of mantra cooldowns to increase, which acts similar to Thunder Wisp.

name: Human Battery
description: When you are out of Ether, convert the Surge stacks of nearby enemies into Ether to pay the cost of your Mantras.
notes: Every Surge stack equates to 10 Ether.
Works on Surge stacks that weren't applied by you.
Does not work on Surge stacks applied to yourself.

name: Both Ends
description: Pressing after landing a light attack with the staff performs a follow-up swing from the opposite end.

prerequisites.prereqValue: Equip any Staff; this Talent is a weapon Talent.

notes: This attack comes out much faster, but only deals 45% of your weapon damage.

name: Counter Spin
description: After blocking an attack, press to counter with your staff.
notes: On proc, swiftly thrust your Staff forwards, dealing 45% of your weapon's damage on hit.

name: Flashboil
description: Landing Ice/fire attacks on burning/chilled enemies extinguishes the flame and generates steam.
notes: Dealing Frostdraw damage to a burning target or Flamecharm damage to a chilled target removes the burn and creates a stationary steam cloud.

The burn status effect doesn't count as "Flamecharm damage" for this Talent, meaning if you apply burn via Agitating Spark, Immolation, or some other non-Flamecharm damaging source to a chilled target, nothing will happen.
Steam clouds deal 2 typeless damage per tick in an AoE at 6 ticks per second. Has a DPS of 12.
Steam clouds are unparryable, unblockable, and bypass armor resistances.
Steam clouds last 5 seconds and have an internal proc cooldown per target of 5 seconds.

This Talent is incredibly good for PvE in high mob density areas like The Diluvian Mechanism because of the AoE nature and long duration per cloud. Additionally, you can create a large amount of steam clouds at the same time by hitting multiple mobs at once.
Mutual Exclusives: Eruption Path: Lava Serpent, Glass Path: Crystallization, Wraith Path: Twisted Puppets

name: Boiling Point
description: Using a fire mantra near your own steam cloud detonates it.
notes: Landing a Flamecharm Mantra on one of your steam clouds causes the cloud to detonate, dealing 10 typeless damage in an AoE.
Because this procs when the steam cloud is hit and not the player, even if your opponent defends against your Mantra, it will still detonate your steam.
Landing a Flamecharm Mantra on a chilled opponent will instantly detonate the newly created steam cloud.
Has a short delay which can throw players off.
The detonation is unparryable, unblockable, and bypasses armor resistances.

name: Action Surge
description: Adrenaline Surge now increases your swing speed by 0.04 for its duration. (+1 Passive Agility)
notes: This is additive with Vigil's Grace, granting +0.06x swing speed when combined.
Both this and Vigil's Grace are applied before Lightning Cloak's swing speed multiplier.

name: Bear Trap
description: Landing a hit with your critical makes your opponent unable to jump for a duration. Also slows your opponent and procs on PvE. (+1 Passive Agility)
notes: The status effect is represented by blood pouring from the legs.
Makes the opponent unable to jump for 4 seconds.
Upon being applied to an opponent, they Bear Trap immunity for 6 seconds.
The Sluggish status effect applies a -15% damage debuff to affected targets.

name: Blade Dancer
description: Landing a Basic Attack removes your roll cooldown. (+1 Passive Agility)
notes: The Monastery Cowl and Deepwoken Cloak equipment have this Talent.

name: Cut to the Chase
description: Air Counter damage scaling is largely increased. Landing an Air Counter now initiates an uppercut. Deal 5% more damage to PvE enemies in the air. (+5 Passive Agility)
notes: Air Counters do not innately deal damage. Having this Talent gives your Air Counter 10 true damage.
The damage bonus to your Air Counters will scale down if you have less than 60 Agility.

Air Counter is initiated when using an Aerial attack after your opponent does any of the following: wall jumps (parkour), uses Wind Step (Galebreathe Talent), uses aerial Arc Beam, is launched into the air by Eyes of Ethiron's one-handed critical, or uses a Lifevent (Starswept jump pad).
Can be synergized with uppercut-based Talents, such as Flaming Flourish.
The old Air Counter Talent was made innate and then reworked into this.

name: Speed Demon
description: Your attacks now inflict a reduced-strength bleed while you have a speed boost. 1s cooldown. (+1 Passive Agility)
notes: Bleed is not accounted for in the damage modifier cap and bypasses armor.
Speed Demon's bleed deals 2.5% of your weapon's damage every 0.3s, three times. This totals to +7.5% damage over a 0.9 second period.
Works with M1s and criticals.

name: Spinning Swordsman
description: Running attacks do +15% extra damage when you have a . (+1 Passive Agility)

name: Oath: Visionshaper
description: You vow to only see that which you wish to see. Reality itself is malleable, pliable to your deft hands. (+1 Support Mantra Slot, +2 Combat Mantra Slots)

prerequisites.prereqValue: bring a Dark Feather to Surge

name: Cheap Trick
description: When hit below half health briefly disappear, leaving behind an illusion clone to keep your enemy occupied for a short duration. Briefly disappear after knocking an enemy.

prerequisites.prereqValue: turn in X Void Feathers to Surge
pay Surge to skip Visionshaper's progression (requires you to have fully progressed the Oath previously).

notes: Being hit while under half HP grants I-frames and turns you invisible for a very short duration. 60s CD.
Knocking an opponent turns you invisible for 2.5 seconds with no I-frames.

name: Reality Shift
description: Command the closest conjured servant to attack their hallucinating target, either using a Critical Attack or a Mantra.

prerequisites.prereqValue: turn in X Void Feathers to Surge
pay Surge to skip Visionshaper's progression (requires you to have fully progressed the Oath previously).

notes: The last non-Oath mantra or critical attack you used before spawning your clones will be stored into the clone. The stored ability will be listed above the clone's head in white text with a purple outline.
Pressing (can be rebinded in settings) or utilizing the Reality Shift tool will make your clones use their stored ability.
Clones created from Mirror Illusion or Illusory Counter's Reversal Spark will copy your opponent's last used critical or Mantra instead.
If the clone is too far away from your opponent upon using Reality Shift, they will teleport to them.
Clones will copy your attunement path and mantra modifiers when utilizing your mantras, but they do not utilize your enchants or most Talents.
Clones will only copy the neutral or aerial criticals of weapons and cannot trigger any other alternate criticals such as running or sliding criticals.

name: Shaper Mimicry
description: The servants you have conjured will imitate your actions when you Swing/Block/Parry/Jump.

prerequisites.prereqValue: turn in X Void Feathers to Surge
pay Surge to skip Visionshaper's progression (requires you to have fully progressed the Oath previously).

notes: Although it isn't listed in the Talent description, your clones will also Vent when you Vent.
Your clones will still Vent even if you don't have enough Tempo.

name: Encore
description: Your sing will stun opponents who are already charmed.
notes: On proc, apply 0.4s of "full stun". This can interrupt enemy attacks.
Doesn't affect allies.

name: Propagandist
description: Your Sing will now stir your allies into a frenzy, causing them to become Overcharmed for 15s, applying Charmed to enemies they hit with Basic Attacks.
notes: Landing M1s and criticals while Overcharmed charms your opponent for 5 seconds (halved to 2.5s if they have Disbelief). Additionally, Overcharm grants a 10% damage bonus to melee attacks when hitting charmed opponents. This bonus does not stack with Tough Love.

name: Vow of Mastery
description: The Vow of Mastery grants the Master the power to command their Subject. To initiate a vow you must ask the other player if they'd like to make the vow. e.g. "wanna make a vow of mastery?"
notes: Players who take the vow are considered allies with their master and others who take the vow.
Commands Given: "Sleep", "Drop", "Run", "Eat", "Say (Text)", "Use", "Locate", "Leech" at base, "Fight", "Sacrifice" at 50 Charisma, "Return" at 60 Charisma and "Explode" at 75 Charisma.

name: Command: Live
description: Once per hour, command a servant to defy all odds and obey your command - live.
notes: Effect: Will fully heal your servant if they have lower than 40% hp
Cooldown scales off the caster's current Charisma investment.

name: Command: Summon
description: Command your servant to obey your summons and appear before you no matter the distance.
notes: Effect: Teleports the subject to the master regardless of distance. Teleportation takes 10 seconds to complete, and any hit will cancel it.
Has a cooldown of 30 seconds for the master and 2 minutes for the subject.

name: Chronostasis
description: Landing a Basic Attack or Critical puts the target's Resonance on cooldown for a short duration, while also applying Ether Sunder to PvE opponents. (+1 Posture)
notes: On hit, apply a 13 second Resonance cooldown.
This cannot proc if their Resonance is already on cooldown.
The Ether Sunder status effect grants you 30% damage reduction against affected enemies' elemental attacks.

name: Conditioned Swimmer
description: You lose less hunger and thirst while swimming. (+1 Passive Agility)

name: Brutal Momentum
description: Successfully dodging will give you hyperarmour on your next swing.
notes: Brutal Momentum works on all heavy weapons, including those who could not utilize this Talent previously like Railblade or Greataxes.
Hyperarmor lasts for 1 second. Successful procs have a cooldown of 8 seconds.

name: Matador
description: Deal +20% more damage to human enemies with hyperarmor.
notes: Doesn't work on Non-Humanoid Monsters.

name: Showstopper
description: When an enemy would roll through one of your physical attacks, stomp the ground, dazing anyone nearby. Removes speed buffs from target upon landing.

name: Switchblade
description: You can now utilize Dagger Talents when not wielding a dagger.

name: Warrior's Swing
description: Reduces incoming damage by 5% if hit during Heavy swing hyperarmor.

name: Haunted Gale
description: Landing 3 Galebreathe Mantras without whiffing calls for a Haunted Phantom. The Phantom will attack alongside you for the next 8s before dissipating.
notes: On proc, gain the Haunted status effect, spawning ghosts that attack your opponent every time you land a Mantra. Only one Ghost can spawn per Mantra.
Gale Wisp increases the duration of Haunted by 3 seconds.
Haunted Gale Ghosts have 7 base damage with 5 Galebreathe scaling.
If your Mantra is blocked, parried, or dodged, it will be "whiffed", resetting all stacks of Haunted Gale.
Haunted Gale stacks are counted per person, not globally.
If you have Apparitions, landing a Galebreathe Mantra while having the Haunted Gale status effect will create an Apparition instead.
Landing non-Galebreathe Mantras will create Haunted Gale's Ghosts even if you have Apparitions.
Having the Freezing Wight Talent will give your Ghosts a Chill proc, the Frostdraw damage type, and an additional 5 Frostdraw scaling.

name: Agility Unbounded
description: You have gained the ability to surpass your limits and train your agility to its fullest.

name: Ash Ember
description: The more wither your opponent has, the more damage your burn deals.
notes: At 90 FLM 90 WPN you gain a 0.0175 burn damage increase per 1 point of wither.
Ash Ember caps at 15 total burn damage.
Every Emperor Flame proc will increase your burn damage by 0.4735, or 1.3125 if you have Scorching Decay.

name: Scorching Decay
description: The wither dealt from your Emperor's Flame is massively increased.
notes: Increases the Wither application from your Emperor Flame from 25 to 75.

name: Brassneck
description: Knocking an enemy grants you 20% damage resistance for 15 seconds.
